title: BCA season: UKVI is checking its list, we’re checking ours twice
summary_en: It’s the most wonderful time of the year. UKVI is checking its list, sponsors are checking theirs twice, we're going to find out who's naughty or nice... but the slight difficulty is that the lack of timely data means the lists won't necessarily match up when it comes to the BCA.
author: Alex Lock and Mike Strong
title_cn: BCA season: UKVI is checking its list, we’re checking ours twice
